questions.question: How do OP-01's two blocking findings (read(0) with bytes remaining; a read after the last byte meeting a failure or a cancellation) enter the frozen record as open items? No skill step codifies it, but O14–O16 (PR review), O17–O26 (audit-025) and O45 (BK-504 table check) were all written outside /observe-review, each group opened by a source line.

options.label: Write O92, O93 now (Recommended)
options.description: This session appends them to Open items, following the audit-025/O45 precedent, with a source line naming the reopen under RFC-0030 C4 (no BK-511 IDs). O92 in reopen shape (D6 conflicts with itself and D155), O93 as a gap in D18. Phase B's /observe walks them directly; the full /observe-review re-run follows per RFC-0030 C3.

options.label: /observe-review OP-01 records
options.description: List both as candidates in BK-485's dossier (the O27–O44 channel) and run a full /observe-review first, which verifies and writes them. Costs an extra full review before the reopen, and that review may add more items that then also block freeze-2.

questions.question: Which freeze tag is BK-506's faithfulness trial subject? Its trial is not pre-registered yet, so RFC-0029 R2's 'keeps that tag' clause does not bind it.

options.label: freeze-2 (Recommended)
options.description: The trial's oracles are written from a record without the two known blocking gaps. BK-506's entry names freeze-2; its Stage 0 dry run can still go ahead, but the run waits for the reopen, review and tag.

options.label: freeze-1
options.description: The trial can start now on a7de4e31, but its E oracles meet two behaviours the record leaves two-valued or undecided, so seeded misreadings touching read(0) or the last-byte read cannot be scored cleanly.

questions.question: Which backlog item carries this reopen (commit prefix, trace, the Phase C entry update)?

options.label: BK-485 (Recommended)
options.description: Its index entry already names this reopen as a step of step 5 ('Not done: that reopen'). New trace sdd/traces/bk-485-op-01-reopen-freeze2.yml; Phase C edits BK-485's entry only.

options.label: New ID
options.description: Mint one with hatch run gen-backlogid-check; a new entry, its own trace, closed at freeze-2, and BK-485's entry links it. More bookkeeping, a separately countable unit.
